files.description: Main certification disclosures page containing the EHI Export Functionality section (~150 words of prose describing C-CDA clinical exports, PDF billing exports, and native format uploads). Also includes MFA, FHIR API, and SED sections. This is the only page with EHI export documentation.

74-page SMART-on-FHIR API documentation for 170.315(g)(10). Covers OAuth 2.0 app launch, FHIR R4 endpoints, and USCDI v3 data class mappings to US Core 6.1.0 profiles. Documents 23 FHIR resources (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Coverage, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Immunization, Location, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, Observation, Procedure, ServiceRequest, Organization, Practitioner, Provenance, RelatedPerson, Specimen). This is the (g)(10) API doc, not (b)(10) EHI export, but relevant for understanding what clinical data the system can expose.

36-page Safety Enhanced Design usability test report (NISTIR 7742) for CarbyOs EHR version 3, dated August 2025. Documents usability testing methodology and results. Not directly relevant to EHI export data content but included as it was linked from the certification disclosures page.
